source_title: 'Eetha' UPDATE: Randeep Hooda's first look as Merchant is out
source_excerpt: The makers of 'Eetha' have introduced Randeep Hooda's character Merchant through a new poster, ahead of the film's trailer launch. The actor plays Anna Sawant Merchant, the husband of legendary Tamasha performer Vithabai Narayangaonkar, in the upcoming biographical drama. Starring Shraddha Kapoor in the titular role, the film is scheduled to reach theaters on December 4, 2026.The first look was released on Friday, October 30, ahead of a promotional event at Mumbai's Plaza Cinema. Randeep Hooda also shared the poster on Instagram, giving audiences their first glimpse of his appearance in the film. His character is expected to be an important part of the story based on Vithabai Narayangaonkar's life.Randeep Hooda introduces his character Merchant in 'Eetha'The actor announced the character reveal through an Instagram post.
